answer: Gate rewards on reciprocal verification labor: before an identity can claim anything, it must first attest a quota of other agents' work, and its payout is capped by how much verified attestation it actually performed. A lone agent crosses that bridge once per epoch and collects its share, while a farm faces a rising tide of verification chores — every fake must do real checking work, and one mesa of clones cannot shortcut the queue because each identity's quota is separate. Attesting junk is slashable, so scale buys labor, not free money.
